notes: Answered in the entry (Lafitte, Aug 10 2026): a(n) = A001177(n) - 1, so fixed points are n with z(n) = n + 1. We add the proof that z(n) = n + 1 forces n prime (p not dividing z(p^e), Fibonacci lifting so z(p^e) = z(p) | p - (5/p), then n + 1 | lcm(p - (5/p)) is too small unless n is prime). Lean: EP_prime (entry point n+1 forces n prime; kam via the Fibonacci matrix over ZMod p, lifting lemma, lcm bound). Outside Lean: Lafitte's continued-fraction lemma a(n) = A001177(n) - 1; certificate/check.py checks the CF definition n <= 400, the z formula n <= 10000, fixed points = A000057 up to 10000, and z(n) = n + 1 only for primes n <= 2*10^5.
